purpose: Numerical validation of framework-independent inference from existing frozen fitted weights, not retraining or statistical equivalence.
cnn_operations: Conv1d cross-correlation 1->64->128->256, valid kernel3; ReLU after each; channel-major flatten; Dense4608->128->64->2, ReLU after first two dense layers.
mlp_operations: Original float64 feature mean/scale; standardise before casting to float32; Dense24->8->2 with ReLU; cast output to float64 before original target-scale/mean inverse transform.
cnn_output_dtype: float64 converted from float32 forward output
numpy_conv_implementation: Sliding-window view, channel-kernel-major im2col, float32 matrix multiplication, float32 bias addition.
reference: Original project Torch prediction functions applied to the same input chunks and same fitted L31 weights.
acceptance_rule: For both models and both batch modes, maximum absolute difference across every x and y coordinate must be <= 0.01 micrometres.
performance_benchmarks: Not authorised to start until root confirms concurrent matched training has finished.
